trust_decision.summary: A redirect target returned by the remote server may only be followed when its scheme equals the scheme of the request that produced it, or when it is https (so http->https upgrades and same-scheme hops, including file->file, stay legal); any other target aborts the chain with InvalidRedirectURL. Decided in HTTPSession.get_redirect_target (fix.diff:39-52), with HTTPSession.resolve_redirects (fix.diff:54-72) suppressing that exception only for the yield_requests=True probe that requests uses for allow_redirects=False. The protected sink is the file:// FileAdapter mounted on the shared session (src/streamlink/session/http.py:126).

landing_point.why: An engineer reading only the summary ('HTTPSession follows HTTP redirects into file:// URLs, reading local files') looks for where file:// becomes fetchable: HTTPSession.__init__ mounts FileAdapter on file://, and the requests-level redirect machinery lives in the same class, so the fix's two new methods land here too.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTPSession.get/head/post/put/delete/patch/options and HTTPSession.send (all via HTTPSession.request -> requests.Session.send -> resolve_redirects); also HTTPSession.resolve_url
HTTPSession.request(..., allow_redirects=False) (requests probes resolve_redirects(yield_requests=True) to fill resp._next) and every hop of a followed redirect chain

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The tree already blocks insecure schemes in playlists/manifests via is_insecure_scheme (src/streamlink/utils/url.py:21, called at src/streamlink/stream/hls/m3u8.py:641 and src/streamlink/stream/dash/manifest.py:316,770), so a solver can argue the session-level redirect check is redundant for stream URL extraction; and because direct file:// input is a documented feature, a solver can argue that only Location targets with scheme file need blocking - which leaves https->http and custom-scheme->http downgrades open, the cases the published tests actually assert.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Two legitimate behaviours sit right next to the sink. (1) Direct file:// playback is a documented feature: HTTPStreamPlugin explicitly accepts file:// input (src/streamlink/plugins/http.py:25, docs/cli/tutorial.rst:50) and HLS/DASH plugins do the same, so removing the file:// adapter mount or rejecting every file:// request breaks users. (2) HTTPSession keeps requests' allow_redirects=False semantics - requests still calls resolve_redirects(yield_requests=True) to fill resp._next, so a fix that raises unconditionally makes an ordinary 3xx response fail instead of returning the response; and http->https upgrade redirects, which are ubiquitous, must keep being followed.

O6_input_shapes: no Location header / empty target (no redirect)
mixed-case scheme in Location (scheme compared lowercased)
multi-hop chain whose second hop is disallowed
allow_redirects=False response shape (only resp._next prepared, no history)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The same origin/scheme policy enforced inside FileAdapter.send, refusing to open a file unless the request chain started at file://
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That method already rejects file: URLs with a hostname component, so a maintainer hardening local-file reads would plausibly put the check at the lowest layer that opens the file instead of in the session.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A public helper that walks Location headers itself (a resolve_url()-style loop, or a resolve_url(..., allow_scheme_change=...) option) and therefore never calls get_redirect_target
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HTTPSession already exposes resolve_url() as public API and Streamlink.resolve_url() uses it via HEAD, so a bespoke redirect-walking helper is a natural place to add a variant.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second copy of the redirect policy: is_insecure_scheme(current, target) extended or wrapped for redirect targets
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project centralises scheme policy in this one function and both the HLS and DASH parsers already call it, so reusing it from the session is the obvious refactor - and it has different rules (it would allow custom-scheme->http).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A plugin-mounted BaseAdapter (like AbemaTVLicenseAdapter) that follows redirects internally with its own request call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugins already mount private-protocol adapters on the shared HTTPSession; an adapter resolving a licence/redirect URL itself would not pass through HTTPSession.resolve_redirects.

O9_family: CWE-73 external control of file name/path - scheme-crossing HTTP redirect reaching the file:// adapter (local file disclosure)

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10, setuptools + versioningit build backend, uv/pip; pytest with pytest-trio, requests-mock and freezegun; ruff for lint; no compiler or JS build

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject only Location targets whose scheme is file (or reuse is_insecure_scheme), which satisfies the file:// example while leaving https->http and custom-scheme->http downgrades open and, if done naively, breaking allow_redirects=False responses.

out_of_scope_notes: CHANGELOG.md:30 records a separate earlier advisory (CVE-2026-44353 / GHSA-hgqw-6m45-hw5f) for file:// URIs inside HLS/DASH playlists; those routes are already protected at the pinned commit (src/streamlink/utils/url.py:21 used at m3u8.py:641 and manifest.py:316,770) and are outside this advisory's redirect scope.
